description: This file contains a test class 'ReminderCancelTest' for testing the reminder cancellation functionality within the 'org.qosp.notes' Android application. It uses JUnit for testing and Koin for dependency injection, focusing on scheduling and cancelling reminders via 'ReminderManager'.

classes.name: ReminderCancelTest
